clue.text: Deluded father jogged round with one athletic club

parts.note: AC = athletic club, as in club names

explanation.surface: A father with delusions of fitness goes for a jog round the track with his athletic club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deluded' sits at the front looking like a description of the jogging father; it is the definition, and the rest is five small pieces laid end to end.
explanation.definitionFit: Here the noun for a sufferer serves as an adjective: paranoia is a mental disorder marked by fixed false beliefs of persecution.

clue.text: Headgear chap praying could perhaps provide

clue.text: Fiddle lazily and with a stiff style

explanation.walkthrough: 'Fiddle' reads as a violin to be played; here it is the verb meaning to cheat or rig.

clue.text: Drug smuggler's refusal to carry Arabian cocaine at first

clue.text: Hesitating? Sure loiter about

indicators.note: letters knocked about, scattered around, end up rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone hanging about undecided is asked if they are hesitating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sure' looks like confident reassurance, the opposite of hesitating, and is only letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain synonym: someone unable to make up their mind wavers, and wavering is what hesitating means.

clue.text: What's pulled wife out of bad car wreck?

explanation.definitionFit: Definition by custom: at British Christmas dinners two people tug the ends of this paper tube until it snaps with a bang.

clue.text: Bad quality insulin sent as ordered

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bad quality' reads as a verdict on the insulin; it is a moral quality, the opposite of saintliness.

clue.text: Bad timing relating to a point in harmony

clue.text: Cards cheat takes in two bridge players — it gives an edge

clue.text: Instant everything is set in position

clue.text: Confused about European banker's small car

clue.text: Execute one parliamentarian — permit having fellows enter

clue.text: Entertainer's beginning with joke outfit

clue.text: Received a name

clue.text: Neglected Saturn, say, because of interest by Newton

clue.text: Hideous newborn's masculine when undressed

clue.text: Genuine about element of part of the eye
